draft.shortGloss: to laugh; to make fun of
draft.emotion: light and spontaneous, a feeling of genuine amusement and joy
notes: Irregular in the present tense: eu rio, você/ele ri, nós rimos, vocês/eles riem.
Takes the preposition 'de' for what you laugh at: 'rir de uma piada' (to laugh at a joke). Do not confuse with 'sorrir' (to smile).

senses.definition: To make sounds with your voice because something is funny or brings joy.
